esco_concept.preferred_label: apply research ethics and scientific integrity principles in research activities

decision.llm_reasoning: The course explicitly mentions training in professional ethics and evaluating situations based on professional ethics principles.

evidence.text: Equip students with an understanding of the practical working environment of information technology enterprises, including production and business processes, as well as information system development and operation processes; while raising awareness of legal regulations, ethical standards, and professional responsibility in practice.

Train students in the ability to apply specialized knowledge to practical work at enterprises; develop teamwork and professional communication skills; and initially analyze and evaluate situations arising in professional practice based on legal principles and professional ethics.
Evaluate and select appropriate behavior in professional situations based on professional ethics principles and social standards in the field of information technology.
